2760.ed: Enduring izakaya restaurant with a wooden interior, known for its beef tongue dishes.
2760.edj: 牛タン料理で有名な、木を基調とした内装の老舗居酒屋。

rv.t: I had been curious about this popular beef tongue restaurant for a while, and when I called just before visiting, I was lucky enough to get a seat. This time was pure luck, but in general, it’s definitely better to make a reservation in advance. The restaurant itself isn’t very spacious, and the seating feels quite tight, with many customers packed into a limited area, so it can get fairly lively depending on the…
Coming from Malaysia, this is truly excellent! Timing was perfect, and mostly are visited by locals. Highly recommended whether alone or in a group 👍😁🇯🇵

Tanyaki offers a warm and authentic Japanese dining experience. The food is freshly prepared, well seasoned, and full of flavor, especially the boiled ox tongue. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, and the staff are friendly and attentive.

2760.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

2761.a: Gyutan no Lemon Asakusa Branch, TACT浅草 2F 2 Chome-9-13 Asakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032, Japan
2761.aj: 〒111-0032 東京都台東区浅草２丁目９−１３ TACT浅草 2F 牛たんの檸檬 浅草店
2761.ed: Diners like this restaurant's thick-cut beef tongue, describing it as incredibly tender, juicy, and flavorful, with many highlighting the excellent set meals that include curry, soup, and rice. They also appreciate the friendly, attentive, and welcoming staff, who often speak English and provide helpful recommendations. Guests mention the vibrant atmosphere and the refreshing lemon soda, which…
2761.edj: クチコミによると、このお店の厚切り牛タンは驚くほど柔らかく、ジューシーで旨味が凝縮されており、多くの人が高く評価しています。カレー、スープ、ご飯がセットになった定食も好評です。また、スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかな対応で、英語を話せる人も多いため、おすすめのメニューを教えてくれるなど、安心して食事を楽しめるという声が多くあります。活気のある雰囲気や、濃厚な料理の味によく合う爽やかなレモンソーダも好評です。

rv.t: Perfect Dining Experience! I visited with a reservation. All staff was incredibly attentive, welcoming, and enthusiastic about recommending their dishes. They had bright smiles on their faces throughout the entire meal, making me feel genuinely welcome. When I was leaving, a staff noticed I had my hands full after settling the bill and thoughtfully asked if I needed any assistance. You can truly feel that the whole…

Didn't know what to expect from tongue restaurant, but was pleasantly surprised. Food was very good, meat was tasty and tender. Sides well matched into sets. Lemon matcha tea was very refreshing and well balanced! Good price for the quality and amount. Despites busy hours the food was served surprisingly quick. Staff is friendly and attentive. Highly recommend!

We were walking around asakusa, looking for a lunch spot and we saw that there was a branch in this area. We decided to try it out. Luckily we had no wait as a walk in if two, and after being seated we ordered our meals. We both tried the thick beef tongue but our extra meats differed. My partner got the normal Wagyu steak and I got the other variation of beef tongue. Everything here was really delicious. The meat…

2761.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2762.a: FUJIYAMA Twin Terrace, Ashigawacho Kamiashigawa, Fuefuki, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0305, Japan
2762.aj: 〒401-0305 山梨県南都留郡笛吹市芦川町上芦川新道峠FUJIYAMAツインテラス ファーストテラス
2762.ed: Visitors say this observation deck offers stunning, unobstructed panoramic views of Mount Fuji and Lake Kawaguchiko. They also highlight the convenience of the shuttle bus service from the parking area, with some opting for the scenic walk. Guests mention the peaceful atmosphere, especially during off-peak seasons, making it ideal for enjoying the scenery.
2762.edj: この展望台を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、富士山と河口湖の遮るもののない素晴らしいパノラマビューが高く評価されています。駐車場からのシャトルバスサービスは便利だという声が多く、中には景色を楽しみながら徒歩を選ぶ人もいるようです。特にオフシーズンは静かな雰囲気で、景色を満喫するのに最適だという感想があります。

rv.t: Amazing place to see mount Fuji! Very few tourists. To get here, drive to the tourist information area or the cafe where you will park your car. Opens at 8:30am to register and pay for the shuttle bus going to the summit. Fee is 1,500 yen and you can stay at the summit up to 3pm which is the last shuttle bus service going back the tourist center. Note: you cant drive up to the summit, you can get there only thru the…
Amazing place. Take the bus ride to the top. Need to climb stairs to reach view point. But view is amazing
most amazing view but its hard to get there without a car from the location you need to park your car and take a bus and the fee is 1500 . best experience ever

2763.a: Japan, 〒110-0013 Tokyo, Taito City, Iriya, 2 Chome−23−14 食堂清月
2763.aj: 〒110-0013 東京都台東区入谷２丁目２３−１４ 食堂清月

rv.t: I ordered the Aji Fry set meal. It came with 2 pieces of fried fish, rice, vegetables and miso soup. The fish was really soft and flaky. Lots of people were turned away while I was there as they were full so I recommend getting there early.

アスパラグリルは、軽めの夕飯としてちょうど良い一品でした。清月のアジフライや生姜焼きと比べると、どうしても満腹度は少し落ちますが、野菜を主役にした料理としてかなり美味しかったです。 アスパラは甘みがあり、焼き目もしっかりついていて香ばしさがあります。一緒に出てくる玉ねぎも美味しく、野菜のグリルがここまで満足感のある料理になるのかと思いました。 ご飯と味噌汁はいつも通りとても美味しいです。こういう基本の部分が安定して美味しいので、何を食べても安心感があります。 アスパラグリルとご飯セットで2,000円くらい。値上がりしている感じはありますが、このご時世ですし、長く続いてほしいお店なので納得しています。 ご夫婦2人でやっている、台東区らしい昔ながらのお店です。派手さはありませんが、何を食べても美味しく、通いたくなるお店です。
外はサクサク、中はふっくらとしたアジフライで、とても美味しかったです。 衣が軽くて油っこさを感じにくく、最後まで飽きずに食べられました。 アジ自体も新鮮で、しっかりとした旨みがあり、ごはんとの相性も抜群でした。 添えられている付け合わせやソースとのバランスもよく、全体的に満足度の高い一皿です。

2764.a: Yadoroku Onigiri Asakusa, キャピタルプラザ浅草 1F 3 Chome-9-10 Asakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032, Japan
2764.aj: 〒111-0032 東京都台東区浅草３丁目９−１０ キャピタルプラザ浅草 1F おにぎり 浅草 宿六
catj: ファースト フード店
2764.ed: Long-standing nook for traditional Japanese rice balls wrapped in seaweed, with seasonal fillings.
2764.edj: 季節の具材を使い海苔で巻いた、日本の伝統的なおにぎりを提供する歴史ある店。

rv.t: 12 seat onigiri joint with deep history. Two rice balls made to order with a generous sheet of nori, takuan, and miso soup - base price ¥1000. No frills. Worth it for the experience, but I wouldn’t wait 40 minutes again to get in.

Simple & Authentic! Great spot for breakfast. Checked out this historic onigiri spot for breakfast today and ordered the Salmon (Sake) onigiri. The flavor was spot on—perfectly seasoned, warm rice, and high-quality nori. Definitely worth a visit if you are looking for an authentic local breakfast in Asakusa!

We really enjoyed dining here when we were in Asakusa last December 2025. The staff/owner were really professional and their service was good. The onigiris were very delicious. As a tourist, it was definitely one experience you should try, dining in this onigiri restaurant. ☺️

2764.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2765.a: Tansōan Kenjirō Handmade Soba Asakusa, 3 Chome-35-3 Asakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032, Japan
2765.aj: 〒111-0032 東京都台東区浅草３丁目３５−３ 丹想庵 健次郎
2765.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious handmade soba noodles and crispy tempura, especially the shrimp kakiage. They also highlight the authentic, cozy atmosphere and the attentive, kind staff who provide excellent service. Guests mention the wide selection of sake and seasonal appetizers, recommending reservations, especially on weekends.
2765.edj: 玄そばを石臼で挽き手打ちした二八の江戸そばや田舎そばなどを看板メニューとする。一品料理や蕎麦懐石も提供。木のぬくもりが漂う店内。

rv.t: This place is so much more than a soba noodle shop, though the soba noodles are absolutely top-notch. The chef makes every dish exciting and new, from young corn still in its husk to grilled duck served with shiitake mushrooms and a variety of herbaceous delights. This guy is not messing around, which explains the love he’s got from Michelin over the years. If you only eat at one place when you come to Asakusa in…

What a wonderful handmade soba restaurant! The tenzaru soba was sublime and brought me immediately back to our time living in Nagano but the real pleasure was the people who own and run this establishment. My partner and I really enjoy soba, but since our time living in Japan she has discovered she has a gluten allergy. Although this soba shop is not gluten free when asked they went out of their way to try and find…

I loved everything about this meal. The noodles are handmade and have that perfect chew. Tempura was crisp and light with super-fresh prawns and vegetables. The chef’s English made ordering easy and chatting fun.

2765.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

rv.t: It's smokers friendly coffee shop which is quite rare in nowadays. Hence childrens are disallowed to enter due to the city law.
A great taste of the Showa period complete with a classic retro menu and a retro arcade table that’s actually still usable!
休日の14時すぎに伺い、待たずに入店できました。 ゲーム筐体がテーブルになっている席があり、ユニークで楽しい雰囲気です。 オムマキを注文。卵で焼きそばを包んだ一品で、やや太めでもっちりした麺が食べごたえあり、美味しかったです。

2767.a: Yuwaeru | Main Store, 谷口化学工業 １階 2 Chome-14-14 Kuramae, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0051, Japan
2767.aj: 〒111-0051 東京都台東区蔵前２丁目１４−１４ 谷口化学工業 １階 結わえる
2767.ed: Old-fashioned self-service restaurant for classic washoku meals comprised of multiple small dishes.
2767.edj: 複数のおかずがある伝統的な和食を提供する、組み合わせ自由の昔なつかしい一膳飯屋。

rv.t: Fermented brown rice (Softer, tastier, and easier to digest) was amazing tasty and must try it! The lunch plate which named “Teisyoku” There were many Japanese style meals “Washoku” If you really like it, try ASAP :)
the fermented brown rice is so good… all of the side dishes were fresh, clean, and of great quality. come at 11:15 if you want to get in the first round of seating for lunch!

The current chef serves a superb meal. While in Japan I visited and eat twice. The menu is amazingly put together and every dish is fantastic! My girlfriend and I enjoyed chef Ryo’s recommendations in a course style. The menu was focused on Enzo deer and it did not disappoint as some of the best deer I have had in addition to the many other plates. Overall a well-priced menu. The top notch Hitachino beer on tap also…

catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2768.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Korean dishes, especially the flavorful ganjang gejang and ganjang saeu, which are often part of generous and satisfying sets. They also highlight the excellent value, with affordable prices for both lunch and dinner, including reasonably priced all-you-can-drink options. Guests mention the clean and spacious interior, along with the friendly and attentive…
2768.edj: この韓国料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、本格的な韓国料理が高く評価されています。特に、風味豊かなカンジャンケジャンとカンジャンセウは、ボリューム満点で満足感のあるセットに含まれていることが多く、人気を集めているようです。ランチ、ディナーともに手頃な価格で、飲み放題もリーズナブルなため、コストパフォーマンスの良さも特徴です。店内は清潔で広々としており、スタッフも親しみやすく丁寧な対応なので、快適な食事の時間を過ごせるとの声が多くあります。

rv.t: I was craving gejang and we were able to find this place near our hotel. The gejang was delicious. We ordered the set meal with the crab, shrimp, rice, soup, etc. The whole set was more than enough to feed the two of us!
Not bad KoraN food 🤙🏼

《カンジャンケジャン＆セウ》 ケジャンは身がとろっとなめらか！セウはぷりっぷり！蟹味噌もたっぷり！特製ダレがしっかり染み込んでいて、口に入れた瞬間に甘みと旨みが広がります😋 《とびこチュモッパ》 自分で混ぜて丸めて作るスタイル！とびっこのプチプチ食感や海苔の風味がアクセント◎ 《サムギョプサル》 お肉は外はカリッと香ばしく、中はジューシー！脂の甘みと肉の旨みが広がります🤤えごまやキムチとさっぱりと🥬 《ケランチム》 ふわっふわの韓国風茶碗蒸し🥚柔らかい食感で優しい味わいで箸休めにも◎ 《マンドゥック》 もちもちの皮の中には餡がぎっしり！ピリ辛な味付けの肉汁の旨みが広がります◎大きめなので食べ応えがありました^_^

2769.ed: Fried pork & noodles in clear broth & topped with boiled eggs at a lively stop with counter seating.
2769.edj: 活気のあるカウンター席のラーメン店。透明感のあるスープに、焼豚とゆで卵をトッピング。

rv.t: STOP going to tourist traps and come here. This is the real stuff. They only accept cash and ONLY 1,000 bank notes, which makes you feel is authentic. You must try it. If they run out of soup they will close, they do it to keep the real flavor

Was recommended by a friend years ago and this time finally got the chance to try. They opened at 11:30am and there’s already a queue at 12pm, they will close upon the soup runs out. We waited like less than 15 mins. The shop is small, have a self-service machine at the door. They actually have 3 options only and we ordered charsiu ramen with seasoned egg - 焼豚らーめん（味玉付き）which is 1,400yen, the soup was really great…
As first time travellers and using tabelog to bring us here was worth every scent, low price and hugh quality food!

2770.a: Japan, 〒151-0051 Tokyo, Shibuya, Sendagaya, 5 Chome−33−16 Tsukemen Gonokami Seisakusho Shinjuku, シャトレー新宿御苑第一 1F
2770.aj: 〒151-0051 東京都渋谷区千駄ケ谷５丁目３３−１６ つけ麺 五ノ神製作所 シャトレー新宿御苑第一 1F
2770.ed: Understated, compact restaurant offering bowls of ramen noodles in a relaxed ambiance.
2770.edj: 落ち着いた雰囲気の店内でラーメンを提供するシンプルでこぢんまりとした店。

rv.t: The tsukemen was excellent. The broth was rich, with a deep seafood flavour and a distinct prawn aroma. The noodles were perfectly springy and had a great texture. I also recommend finishing the meal with soup wari—it lightens the broth and makes for a satisfying end to the noodles.

I don't even know where to start with this place. If you love tsukemen, this is an absolute must-visit. The long queue is completely worth it. I tried the original shrimp tsukemen, and it was incredible. The dipping broth is rich, intensely flavorful, and packed with the aroma of shrimp. It was a little salty for my taste, but somehow I just couldn't stop eating. The noodles were thick, chewy, and had a wonderfully…

Came at 11.45 am and there was a small line. Managed to beat the corporate lunch crowd. Got in after 15-20 mins wait, the line moves quickly. Had the tomato shrimp Tsukumen which probably is the most popular dish. The broth is rich with shrimp flavours and the Tsukumen is cooked to the right firm texture tossed in with a pesto sauce. Overall highly recommended to try if you're looking for a good Tsukumen

2770.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2771.a: Ramen Yamaguchi, 3 Chome-13-4 Nishiwaseda, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 169-0051, Japan
2771.aj: 〒169-0051 東京都新宿区西早稲田３丁目１３−４ らぁ麺やまぐち
2771.ed: Small ramen shop serving thin ramen noodles with hearty, soy-based chicken broths & dipping sauces.
2771.edj: こぢんまりとしたラーメン店。細麺と鶏ダシのスープを組み合わせたボリュームたっぷりの醤油ラーメンや、つけ麺が人気。

rv.t: Top rated, chicken based broth serving simple but wholesome tastes. The chicken base makes it feel lighter & less fatty than others, easy to drink until the last drop, filling you up without fulling you out. If that even makes sense... There is a standard price for the base set, sold via vending machine, with egg/noodles/extra meat (pork or chicken) as potential add-ons. Take a ticket and a seat, food comes out…

We came around 5PM on weekends and waited around 20mins to get seats. The noodles were tasted pretty amazing. Soup was not heavy at all. The atmosphere was very nice as they were controlling the number of people stays in the store. Average adult male cost is around 2000円(A noodle set and single topping) ‼️Important reminders‼️ - the store does not accept cash payment. People needs to use credit cards and online…
Incredible ramen. One chef prepares everything with great precision. The broth for both the salt and the soy based ramen is not too heavy. It is a popular place in the area and deservedly so.

2771.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2772.a: Sosakumen Kobo Nakiryu, ＳＫＹ南大塚 １F 2 Chome-34-4 Minamiotsuka, Toshima City, Tokyo 170-0005, Japan
2772.aj: 〒170-0005 東京都豊島区南大塚２丁目３４−４ ＳＫＹ南大塚 １F 創作麺工房 鳴龍
2772.ed: Renowned ramen eatery with just a few counter seats, serving a range of choice noodle soups.
2772.edj: カウンター席のみで席数はわずかながら、有名なラーメン店。さまざまな種類の麺料理を提供。

rv.t: You can grab a ticket for your preferred timeslot. Entry may be a little after your assigned time, and food can take a while since they’re only a crew of two. For reference, I picked the 1:30 PM slot, entered 1:45 PM, and had my food served around 2:10 PM. Both the tantanmen and wontons were worth the wait. The tantanmen had a rich, flavorful broth with plenty of nuttiness. It was rich, but not too thick or heavy. I…

We showed up at about 7:50am to get a reservation when the tickets opened at 8am. There were only a few people ahead of us in line and it was quite easy to get a time slot. The food was good, however, we had much better in Tokyo without the Michelin mention. This place is good, but not worth coming early to get a ticket.

You have to get a reservation ticket from the front of the restaurant. The ticketing starts from 8am and ends when all tickets are given. The restaurant is tiny so when going with bigger groups your time slot may be even later. Then, simply appear in front of the restaurant 5 minutes before your seating time. The dan dan ramen was not as amazing as thought, probably the tsukemen version would have stronger…

2773.a: Yoroiya, 1 Chome-36-7 Asakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032, Japan
2773.aj: 〒111-0032 東京都台東区浅草１丁目３６−７ 浅草名代らーめん 与ろゐ屋
2773.ed: Low-key venue for ramen soups with double-yolked eggs, said to be a good-luck symbol, plus gyoza.
2773.edj: 幸運の象徴である「双子の玉子」を添えたラーメンを提供する簡素なラーメン店。餃子もある。

rv.t: Simple yet delicious ramen and pan-fried dumplings; the owner and staff are clearly passionate and dedicated to both the service and the food preparation. Whether you sit at the ground-floor counter or dine upstairs, the atmosphere is very comfortable. The chicken dumplings, served with dipping sauce and vinegar, are wonderfully light and tasty. The soy sauce ramen has a rich, mellow flavor. A vegetarian menu is…

We ordered the Shoyu Ramen, Yuzu Ramen, Tsukemen, gyoza, and chashu rice bowl — everything was delicious! The broth was rich and flavorful without being too heavy, and the noodles had a great texture. The Tsukemen noodles were chewy and paired perfectly with the dipping broth. The Yuzu Ramen was especially refreshing with a light citrus aroma that made it unique. The gyoza was crispy on the outside and juicy inside…

It's really good ramen, despite being in a super touristy area! I liked both the soup noodles and the tsukemen. The soy sauce soup noodles has a nice chicken flavor with a hint of yuzu. It was light enough to drink as a souo, but flavorful enough to eat with the noodles. I drank all the broth :). The tsukemen noodle texture is great for dipping. The char siu for the tsukemen is flamed, which gave it a nice slightly…

2774.a: Japan, 〒248-0005 Kanagawa, Kamakura, Yukinoshita, 1 Chome−6−28 ランプ雪ノ下 2A RURU KAMAKURA
2774.aj: 〒248-0005 神奈川県鎌倉市雪ノ下１丁目６−２８ ランプ雪ノ下 2A RURU KAMAKURA
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2774.ed: Visitors say this cafe offers delicious matcha and sweets, including seasonal mousse, served on unique water tables that create a beautiful, photo-worthy interior. They also highlight the calm, comfortable atmosphere, making it a great spot to relax with friends or family. Some reviews mention the latte can be overly sweet.
2774.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェではおいしい抹茶や、季節のムースを含むスイーツが楽しめると評判です。水が張られたユニークなテーブルで提供され、店内は美しく、写真映えすると好評です。また、落ち着いた心地よい雰囲気も特徴で、友人や家族とリラックスするのに最適な場所として挙げられています。 一方で、ラテが甘すぎると感じる人もいるようです。

rv.t: Tldr - it’s great for instagram photos but it’s a bit overhyped. It’s a small space with limited seating since it’s just one table but we didn’t have to wait for seats since there were barely any people there. I loved the decoration, the explanations and advices I got and finally been convinced to purchase a matcha set to bring back home ( with VAT deducted ). A nice, professional and succulent place to visit.

I got to know this tea shop from visiting many famous restaurants in Tokyo, and most of them choose to use this brand of tea. As a result, every time I come to Tokyo, I always make a point to stop by and buy tea or enjoy a cup of tea with pastries here. The tea is of good quality and reasonably priced compared to the quality of the tea itself and compared to other shops. The staff provides excellent service, and…

Each visit is limited to one hour, so I recommend ordering a set to sample a variety of items. You can even adjust the sweetness level to your liking. A must-visit for matcha lovers!

2789.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and rich Basque cheesecakes, which come in various rotating flavors and are often topped with ice cream and animal crackers. They also highlight the excellent coffee and espresso drinks, noting the staff's careful preparation. Guests mention the casual, standing-style atmosphere, which is ideal for a quick stop, and appreciate the friendly and welcoming staff.
2789.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくて濃厚なバスクチーズケーキが高く評価されています。バスクチーズケーキは日替わりで様々な味が提供されており、アイスクリームや動物の形をしたクラッカーが添えられていることが多いようです。また、丁寧に淹れられたコーヒーやエスプレッソドリンクも評判です。店内はカジュアルな立ち飲みスタイルで、ちょっと立ち寄るのに最適という声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、歓迎してくれるという感想も寄せられています。

rv.t: Amazing cup of cappuccino! Strong aromatic and full of flavor coffee. Definitely gonna drink my morning coffee there. The barista is very welcoming and friendly opened to talk about the origin of the beans and any possible curiosities

Taka is the nicest owner on earth. Best latte so far in Tokyo in my humble experience, the thickness of the milk with coffee fruity note is incredible. Thank you Taka for making such great coffee and cheesecake! Will definitely comeback for more coffee whenever I’m in Tokyo. Much love from Vietnam.

Tokyo has many great cafes. But this is the best. The test of a good cafe and a good barista is how well they make a black coffee - natural coffee without anything added. At Tiny Paradise it is perfect! I come to Tokyo several times a year - and the first stop is always this cafe. Love it. Edit April 2025: Still coming to Tokyo and still loving Tiny Paradise. It just gets better! Edit June 2025: This time I was…

2790.a: Japan, 〒131-0045 Tokyo, Sumida City, Oshiage, 1 Chome−1−2 THE MATCHA TOKYO SKYTREE Solamachi
2790.aj: 〒131-0045 東京都墨田区押上１丁目１−２ THE MATCHA TOKYO SKYTREE Solamachi

rv.t: Stopped by The Matcha Tokyo at Skytree and had their Premium Matcha Latte (¥1,200). A little pricey for a drink, but the quality of the matcha definitely shows. Rich, smooth, and not overly sweet with a deep matcha flavour. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. A nice treat if you’re exploring the area and want a good matcha experience. Ice cream too was like ¥560 🍵 TL;DR: Expensive, but excellent service.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ THE MATCHA TOKYO SKYTREE Solamachi was a really nice stop while exploring the Skytree area and a great place to try high-quality matcha desserts. The drinks and soft serve were smooth, rich and well balanced, with a strong matcha flavour that wasn’t overly bitter or too sweet. The shop itself was clean and modern, and it fit perfectly within the Tokyo Skytree Solamachi complex, making it easy to grab…

The ‘recommended’ and ‘most popular’ matcha are just below average. The recommended is pure matcha, but has 0 matcha taste and fragrance is nonexistent. It’s like drinking chlorophyll. I can only describe it as tasteless. The most popular is matcha latte, way too sweet and due to using raw cane sugar, the sweetness tastes weird. The cake is alright, nothing special. This cafe caters way too much towards tourists…

2791.a: Hatoya Asakusa, 2 Chome-14-3 Hanakawado, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0033, Japan
2791.aj: 〒111-0033 東京都台東区花川戸２丁目１４−３ 八十八浅草/Hatoya Asakusa
catj: 伝統的な紅茶・緑茶店
2791.ed: People say this matcha shop offers delicious, rich matcha and hojicha drinks, with many enjoying the option to add matcha ice cream or seasonal fruit sauces. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, many of whom speak English and explain the preparation process. Visitors appreciate the quick service despite long queues, and the opportunity to watch their drinks being made fresh.
2791.edj: この抹茶店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくて濃厚な抹茶やほうじ茶のドリンクが高く評価されています。抹茶アイスクリームや季節のフルーツソースを追加できる点も好評です。また、スタッフは親切で気配りができ、英語を話せる人も多く、ドリンクの準備工程を説明してくれるという声もあります。長い行列にもかかわらず、提供が早いことや、目の前でドリンクが作られる様子を見られることも、訪れた人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: We went to queue 30 mins before their opening and was the 15th in queue. We queue for 15 mins after opening to order and waited for another 15 mins before we got our order. Ordered the matcha latte and added whip cream to it. The matcha felt abit too creamy for my liking. The matcha flavour was not prominent enough that we can’t really taste it. Would prefer if the matcha taste was stronger. On photos it looks…

I reached around 3pm+, there was only few people infront of me. The que move fast. Before i can decide what i want it was my turn 😂 i told the staff i like nutty kind of matcha and she recommend the ni latte. I added ice cream too, 1800yen for a matcha 😅 They will give you a number tab and call you when it is your turn, confirm your order and you can start taking video. Overall the experience was good and matcha was…

Hands down some of the best matcha I've ever had in Japan! You can tell they take their tea incredibly seriously. The matcha is rich, earthy, and perfectly balanced without being overly bitter or masked by too much milk. Watching the staff whisk the matcha right in front of you is such a cool experience. It’s an absolute must-visit for any true matcha fan!

2792.a: epulor, Escenario Aobadai, 1F 1 Chome-19-10 Aobadai, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0042, Japan
2792.aj: 〒153-0042 東京都目黒区青葉台１丁目１９−１０ エスセナーリオ青葉台 1F epulor
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2792.ed: People say this cafe and bar offers a wide selection of coffee, wine, and unique desserts like the rich matcha terrine and distinctive black cheesecake. Visitors highlight the cozy, stylish atmosphere with vinyl records playing, making it a great spot to relax. They also mention the professional staff and the option to enjoy it as a cafe during the day or a bar at night.
2792.edj: このカフェバーを利用した人は、コーヒーやワイン、濃厚な抹茶テリーヌや特徴的な黒いチーズケーキといった珍しいデザートが豊富に揃っていると評価しています。レコードが流れる居心地の良いおしゃれな雰囲気は、リラックスするのに最適な場所として好評です。また、プロフェッショナルなスタッフの対応も良いという意見や、昼はカフェ、夜はバーとして楽しめる点も評価されています。

rv.t: The atmosphere and the music are very good. The drinks are also ok. However, they took orders and made drinks for the Japaneses first, even though they came much later than us. We sat at the bar but no staff greeted or talked to us for a long time, until we decided to ask if we can order. It’s like we’re invisible. Edited: The owner’s comment suggested that they hadn’t noticed us. In reality, they told us to sit at…

The quality of service has really decreased. One of the staff members was very unfriendly, especially toward a family with a child. The child was very quiet, yet he still created unnecessary problems about the stroller—even though the place was empty. We explained that we could fold the stroller and keep it with us, but he immediately refused in a rude way. Only after insisting did he reluctantly accept, even though…
Amazing bar, cozy vibes, excellent sound system and records, simple menu but good drinks The staff is discreet, elegant, and professional Very romantic !

2792.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

2793.a: Soyo caffe, 2 Chome-2-5 Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0002, Japan
2793.aj: 〒150-0002 東京都渋谷区渋谷２丁目２−５ SOYO CAFE
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: If you want to enjoy some matcha in a relaxing environment, Soyo Caffe is the place to be 🧘‍♀️ Since I came on a weekday, there was hardly any people inside and I was able to get my order right away. I had an iced matcha latte and loved that I was able to pour the matcha myself 🤩 They definitely get an A+ for presentation! In terms of taste, this matcha is more on the sweet side. I normally prefer my matcha to be…

I really enjoyed this cafe. It’s small and cozy, with a laidback vibe. It’s a place you can sit and relax for a while. I ordered the drip coffee and it was done well. I also went with the matcha cheesecake, which was delicious. It was creamy and not overpowered by the green tea taste. The staff were friendly and the service fast.

Hojicha terrine cake (I have peanut allergy and sweet lady kindly replaced it with whipped cream) & hot matcha latte - fire 🔥 love this place n great early morning start. Friendly staff, cozy space, and very sweet staff! <3

2794.a: Japan, 〒162-0811 Tokyo, Shinjuku City, Suidocho, 2−3 星川ビル 1階 Cafe 1 Part
2794.aj: 〒162-0811 東京都新宿区水道町２−３ 星川ビル 1階 Cafe 1 Part
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2794.ed: Diners like this cafe's rich and smooth Basque cheesecake and matcha terrine, along with a wide variety of delicious coffee and other drinks. They also highlight the beautiful latte art and the calm, relaxing atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service, making it a pleasant experience.
2794.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、なめらかで濃厚なバスクチーズケーキや抹茶テリーヌ、美しいラテアートを含む豊富な種類のドリンクが高く評価されています。また、落ち着いた雰囲気とスタッフの丁寧で親しみやすいサービスも特徴です。

rv.t: A small cafe with a great ambiance. We went on a weekend and we had to queue for about 40 mins. There were only 2 tables inside and several counterseats. Only 1 staff inside but despite the place being busy. He was very nice and friendly. Great customer service. Several modes of payments were available too. We ordered the Basque Cheesecake, Matcha Terrine, Iced Cafe Latte & Hot Matcha Latte. The cakes were…

Lovely cafe with amazing cakes! Variety of yummy cakes and drinks available. Every drink is made to order and you can tell a lot of attention has gone into the food and drinks with the drinks having amazing latte art too. We got the Mont Blanc basque cheesecake (seasonal flavour), matcha terrine and canele. All were very delicious but the basque cheesecake was the stand out. Just expect a bit of a wait especially on…

JAN 2026 Re-visited for the matcha terrine and it was just as good as I remembered it to be. Also got a hot matcha latte and a retro pudding. The matcha latte was unsweetened, pretty good but personally I think coffee would pair better with the matcha terrine. Retro pudding has some volume and slight graininess, not the silky smooth type; it was quite tasty with the caramel sauce. MAR 2024 Visited the café early in…

2794.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2795.a: SUZU CAFE Roppongi, 相鉄フレッサイン 3 Chome-10-1 Roppongi, Minato City, Tokyo 106-0032, Japan
2795.aj: 〒106-0032 東京都港区六本木３丁目１０−１ 相鉄フレッサイン SUZUCAFE roppongi
2795.ed: People say this cafe offers a wide variety of delicious food, including satisfying lunch plates, pasta, and popular matcha pudding. They also highlight the spacious and comfortable seating, making it a great spot for various occasions. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
2795.edj: ヴィンテージのソファーやテーブルを配したスタイリッシュな店内で、ドリンクとイタリア料理を中心に提供。朝食ビュッフェやランチもある。

rv.t: Super happy with this little café, the coffee was great, the alcohol was great, the cheesecake was great, and the pancakes were great! Also, they think a shot of whiskey is a triple shot of whiskey, so if you’d like whiskey, make sure you come here!

Really disappointing experience here. I’ve had great visits at suzu ginza before. That’s actually why I brought some friends who were visiting but honestly, I regret choosing this place. Right from the start, the service felt off. The young male staff didn’t greet us or guide us at all, just kind of stood there. When we ordered, it was pretty frustrating. We had to repeat everything multiple times because he didn’t…

Came here on our first day in Japan for breakfast. The buffet was laid out nicely and had several choices. Tried a little bit of everything. I would recommend staying away from the scrambled eggs. They were undercooked and cold, but I tried them anyways. Ended up with food poisoning and was very ill. Three days later and I’m finally back on track overall not a bad place and everything else was good.

2796.a: IPPUKU & MATCHA, Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower, １階, 2 Chome-1-1 Nihonbashimuromachi, Chuo City, Tokyo 103-0022, Japan
2796.aj: 〒103-0022 東京都中央区日本橋室町２丁目１−１ 日本橋三井タワー １階 IPPUKU&MATCHA
2796.ed: People say this matcha specialty store offers rich, authentic matcha drinks and delicious desserts like the creamy basque cheesecake and matcha pudding. They also highlight the comfortable outdoor seating with heaters, and the option to reserve a private tea room for a unique experience. Visitors appreciate the friendly and helpful staff.
2796.edj: この抹茶専門店を利用した人は、濃厚で本格的な抹茶ドリンクや、クリーミーなバスクチーズケーキ、抹茶プリンなどのデザートを高く評価しています。また、暖房設備のある快適なテラス席や、特別な体験ができる予約制の個室の茶室も好評です。スタッフは親切で対応が良いという意見が多くあります。

rv.t: Excellent matcha spot with a great selection of drinks and desserts. The matcha is rich, authentic, and made with high-quality Uji matcha. The staff was friendly and service was quick. A perfect place for matcha lovers, whether you’re looking for a refreshing drink or a sweet treat. Definitely worth a visit! 🍵💚

JAN 2026 Made a reservation in advance for the private tea room which can seat up to four people. If you come alone, you can have the tea room all to yourself. I pre-ordered the matcha parfait and chose the matcha tasting experience which gives you the option to choose two single origin Uji matcha out of the five different ones they have. The parfait was brought out to me first and then the staff proceeded to whisk…

Came here about 7 pm on a Friday night in early July. It was not too crowded as they close at 8 pm. If you enjoy single origin uji-grown matcha, this is the place. Otherwise, it may just taste like grass.

2796.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2797.a: Kyoto Saryo-suisen Shinjuku Branch, Shinjuku Sumitomo bldg., 1階 2 Chome-6-1 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 163-0201, Japan
2797.aj: 〒163-0201 東京都新宿区西新宿２丁目６−１ 新宿住友ビル 1階 京都 茶寮翠泉 新宿店
2797.ed: Diners like this cafe's freshly made warm warabi mochi and rich matcha desserts, including parfaits and soft serve. They also highlight the calm atmosphere and the staff's attentive service. Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
2797.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、出来立ての温かいわらび餅や、パフェ、ソフトクリームなどの濃厚な抹茶デザートが高く評価されています。また、落ち着いた雰囲気やスタッフの丁寧なサービスも特徴です。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧でないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: The matcha soft serve had a nice flavour to it, while the matcha latte was rich and refreshing. The warabi-mochi was a nice sticky treat, big in portion and with a really lovely coating that added to the flavour. A really lovely place for a quick dessert break with a wide variety available, though the pr can be slightly expensive.

I visited the Kyoto Saryo Suisen Shinjuku branch in November 2025. It's located on the ground floor of the Shinjuku Sumitomo Building, on the quieter, more business oriented side of Shinjuku. It can be a little tricky to find at first, but once you enter the Sumitomo Building, stay on the ground floor and head towards the West side. You will see "Cafe and Bar" written on the outside, which can be confusing since the…
We had two Matcha Latte with beautiful cream foam on it. Also had a Cold Warabi Mochi with tea. It was good. Some beverages require a 20 mins preparation but we were ok with that. Very tasty. 8/10

2798.a: Japan, 〒155-0031 Tokyo, Setagaya City, Kitazawa, 2 Chome−26−18 アーバンテラス下北沢 201 CAPOON抹茶製造所 下北沢
2798.aj: 〒155-0031 東京都世田谷区北沢２丁目２６−１８ アーバンテラス下北沢 201 CAPOON抹茶製造所 下北沢
2798.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious matcha drinks and desserts, including the popular matcha cheesecake and roll cake, with options to adjust sweetness. They also highlight the cozy and clean atmosphere, along with the friendly and attentive staff. Guests mention the reasonable prices for the quality and the convenient option to customize drinks with non-dairy milk.
2798.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、人気の抹茶チーズケーキやロールケーキをはじめとする、抹茶を使ったおいしいドリンクやデザートが高く評価されています。甘さの調整ができる点も好評です。店内は居心地が良く清潔感があり、スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応だとされています。価格は品質に見合ったもので、乳製品以外のミルクでドリンクをカスタマイズできるのも便利だという声があります。

rv.t: I went on Wednesday afternoon. Chill atmosphere and nice staff. I ordered a Matcha Cheesecake and an Ice Hojicha Latte. The Cheesecake is amazingly delicious! Having it with salt on the side makes it even more better✨ Hojicha latte will never failed me, I love it. It’s good that the shop makes you choose how sweet you like for your drink. 💯

Great matcha desserts. There’s a nice combo set with a matcha cheese cake, a matcha roll cake, and a matcha scone. Apart from matcha, there are some other drink options like hojicha latte. You can also change the milk to soy milk or some other non-dairy. When I went, they had oats milk instead.
Ordered their matcha scone and doubt shot of matcha. The scone wasnt sweet which is very good. The matcha is very nice, next time I guess one shot is good for me.

2799.aj: 〒130-0004 東京都墨田区本所２丁目１６−５ safn° サフン KAIKA 東京 by THE SHARE HOTELS 1F STORAGE 1
2799.ed: Diners like this cafe's rich, firm puddings and delicious coffee, with many highlighting the popular matcha options. They also appreciate the stylish, art-filled atmosphere and the availability of power outlets. Other reviews mention popular items can be sold out.
2799.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、濃厚で弾力のあるプリンと美味しいコーヒーが高く評価されており、特に人気の抹茶メニューを挙げる人が多くいます。また、おしゃれでアート作品が飾られた雰囲気や、電源コンセントが利用できる点も好評です。 一方で、人気のメニューは売り切れていることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I found this place because it was one of the few coffee spots open from 7:00 AM - and it turned out to be a great surprise. The coffee was really good, and there was even a small art exhibition to enjoy while sipping it. The café is located inside a hotel lobby that also serves as an art gallery, with plenty of seating and a peaceful, library-like atmosphere. Maybe it was just the early hour, but it was quiet, calm…

We come to this cafe at least once a week since October. It is the perfect place to work, the coffee is so good, and we love the chocolate banane muffin, it is the best we have ever tried. We take it every time. They have nice seats with plugs at almost every table. This week alone we went 3 times !

The matcha pudding was very nice - creamy, rich, not too sweet. The ice cream was a perfect addition providing some sweetness to create balance. So, I can say it lived up to the hype. The matcha latte was good, but it didn't blow me away. Unfortunately, there was a bit of a wait around 3pm. I'd say around 30 minutes before I was seated. It was a little frustrating to see some customers lingering after finishing…

2800.a: Izakaya Hachiku, 中林ビル 1階 2 Chome-8-7 Misakicho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0061, Japan
2800.aj: 〒101-0061 東京都千代田区神田三崎町２丁目８−７ 中林ビル 1階 居酒屋破竹 水道橋店
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店

rv.t: Taste good and service is good too. Recommended for food around Tokyo Dome. Btw, the restaurant accepted reservation from Google map which is great for foreigners. Credit card is also accepted.

Wonderful experience here. Ordered several different plates and particularly enjoyed the salmon sashimi and fried fish and cheese balls. There is a minimum one drink per person requirement. Staff was friendly and provided an English menu, and did their best to explain the dishes. This was a welcome change after being denied entry at a nearby sushi restaurant due to being foreigners. Thank you for your patience with…
Lovely place. Perfectly poured draft beer, good food and very friendly service.

2801.a: Japan, 〒101-0051 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kanda Jinbocho, 1 Chome−４２−8 エスペランサ神田神保町 1F 海南鶏飯本舗
2801.aj: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町１丁目４２−８ エスペランサ神田神保町 1F 海南鶏飯本舗
2801.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and tender Hainanese chicken rice, with options to customize rice type, meat cut, and portion size. They also highlight the nine different sauces available for varied flavor, and appreciate the reasonable prices. Others mention the clean restrooms and the cozy, unpretentious atmosphere.
2801.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しくてやわらかい海南鶏飯（ハイナンチキンライス）を高く評価しています。ライスや鶏肉の種類、量を選んでカスタマイズできる点も好評です。また、9種類のソースで様々な味を楽しめることや、手頃な価格も魅力のようです。清潔なトイレや、居心地の良い気取らない雰囲気も良いというクチコミがあります。

rv.t: I really enjoyed their Hainanese Chicken Rice here. The chicken was incredibly tender and succulent, served alongside fragrant rice that absorbed all the savory juices. What set this place apart was the freedom to customize my plate. They provided a variety of seasonings and sauces at the table, allowing me to tailor the flavor profile exactly to my liking, whether I wanted it extra spicy, ginger-heavy, or balanced…

🥢 Delicious & healthy Thai lunch in Jimbocho 🇹🇭🍽️ Tried a half & half plate of Khao Man Gai and Gapao Rice at Hainan Jeefan Honpo — the perfect combo for indecisive foodies! 😋 🍚 I chose jasmine rice and sous-vide chicken breast — unbelievably tender and juicy thanks to the low-temperature cooking method. ✨ You can customize both the rice and the meat. All this for just ¥1,190 — amazing value for such a…

You can choose the parts of chicken as well as rice kinds. There are also spice set on the table which you should try various taste. But ginger is the best with Khao Man Kai. Lunch is very crowded so recommend to give at least 30 mins before lunch time. There are also a lot of people for take out.

2802.a: ChatGatto, 1 Chome-54-19 Kanda Jinbocho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0051, Japan
2802.aj: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町１丁目５４−１９ 神保町ワイン食堂ChatGatto 自然な味わいのワインと愛媛の食材

rv.t: Hidden gem. Excellent place for romantic dinner or dinner for four. Homemade, delicious French and Italian dishes. Exquisit organic wine selection. Run by lovely couple, husband is the Italian chef, wife in charge of French dishes. Highly recommended. Try the basil sorbet for desert and/or the duck for main dish. 2816.edj: この韓国料理店を利用した人は、本格的で美味しいトッポギ、特に人気のロゼトッポギを高く評価しています。また、ボリューム満点な点も好評です。店内は清潔感があり、スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応だと評価されています。無料のケランチム（韓国風茶碗蒸し）が提供されることや、辛さの調整ができる点も良いというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Had the regular rosé tteokbokki and the size was massive! My friend and I shared one bowl, ate our fill, and we both still had a full portion left for a meal the following day. We chose the "less spicy" option and it was still quite spicy! The taste was good, will be back again for the next tteokbokki craving.
Fabulous taste, and actually spicy! I recommend spicy level 4 for Americans who like a lot of spice but are not used to Korean levels of spice.

I’ve been a regular here for about 4 years. I always get the rose tteokbokki and the consistency varies every time I come. Sometimes it’s watery and sometimes it’s nice and thick, but tasty all the same. It’s spicier than most tteokbokki places I’ve been to in Japan honestly. The fluffy egg is probably my favorite thing to get here :)
